title: Automated Windows enumeration
description: Windows counterpart to linpeas. Flags misconfigs, stored creds and weak services.
output: Highlighted findings across services, registry, creds and token privileges.

title: List token privileges
description: Shows privileges on the current token. SeImpersonate opens the Potato attack family.
output: Privilege list with state. Enabled SeImpersonate/SeAssignPrimaryToken are gold.

title: Map missing patches to CVEs
description: WES-NG parses `systeminfo` output and maps missing patches to known CVEs and available exploits. Save systeminfo to a file, then feed it in. https://github.com/bitsadmin/wesng
output: Applicable CVEs, missing KBs and possible exploits for the host.

title: Monitor process / file / registry
description: Sysinternals real-time monitor of file, registry and process/thread activity. For privesc, spot unquoted service paths, missing DLLs (hijack) and files a SYSTEM process touches. Filter to cut the noise.
output: A live, filterable event stream revealing writable targets a privileged process uses.
